hooks.basisCli: As the coding agent lists them now for this session's settings. The session read its own when it started.
hooks.basisLaunch: As the session's settings files were when it started. The coding agent doesn't say which of them it loaded.
hooks.firedWhat: Combwork's own hooks it received, newest first (the last 50): Combwork's reply, and what Combwork made of it. Other hooks aren't seen by Combwork.
hooks.ledger: {ledger, select, applied {Applied} continued {Carried on by Combwork} ignored {Ignored} other {Not reached}}
hooks.notRunning: The agent isn't running: its hooks are listed while it runs.
hooks.note.changed: {file} has changed since the session started. This list is the session's start; what it loads now isn't known.
hooks.note.cliUnknown: The coding agent couldn't list its hooks ({why}): only Combwork's are shown, and whether others load isn't known.
hooks.note.more: {n, plural, one {# more hook} other {# more hooks}} not listed.
hooks.note.notJson: {file} isn't valid JSON, so the coding agent skips it: its hooks aren't listed.
hooks.note.othersUnread: The coding agent may also load hooks Combwork doesn't read (its own plugins, the folder's). Only Combwork's are listed.
hooks.note.unreadable: {file} couldn't be read ({why}): its hooks aren't listed.
hooks.response: {response, select, none {Nothing to say} context {Sent context} allowed {Allowed} warned {Allowed, with a warning} asked {Asked you} blocked {Blocked} error {Error} other {Unknown}}
hooks.snippet.allowlists: If the managed settings set allowedHttpHookUrls, add {url} to it; if they set httpHookAllowedEnvVars, add CW_HOOK_TOKEN.
hooks.snippet.notListening: Combwork's Agent API isn't listening on port {port} now (another program may be using it), so hooks sent there won't reach Combwork until it is.
hooks.snippet.otherPort: Also for {build, select, dev {a development build} other {the installed app}} of Combwork (port {port})
hooks.snippet.port: Its hooks name Combwork's Agent API port, {port}. If that port changes (Settings → Agent API), the administrator pastes a new snippet.
hooks.snippet.statusLine: Include Combwork's status line (cost, plan limits, model). It replaces any status line the organisation's managed settings set, in every Claude Code session on the computer, and shows nothing.
hooks.snippet.title: Claude Code admin snippet
hooks.snippet.what: Where an organisation's Claude Code policy allows only managed hooks (allowManagedHooksOnly), Combwork's own hooks don't run, and Combwork can't tell what its agents are doing. An administrator can paste this block into the organisation's managed settings once: it gives Claude Code Combwork's hooks for every session, every account and every project, and does nothing in sessions Combwork didn't start. It holds no password or token.
hooks.source: {source, select, combwork {Combwork} managed {Managed settings} cli {Command line} project {Project} local {Project (local)} user {User} plugin {Plugin} other {Other}}
hooks.stale: The agent has restarted since this was read: it shows its earlier session.
hooks.status: {status, select, passed {Passed by Combwork} trusted {Trusted} untrusted {Not trusted: won't run} modified {Changed since trusted: won't run} unverified {Configured · loading unverified} disabled {Turned off} notLoaded {Not loaded} unsupported {Unknown form} other {Unknown}}
hooks.title: Hooks: {agent}
hooks.what: The hooks this agent's session has, and what Combwork received from them. Combwork only shows them here: it never changes or turns off a hook.
